content.vision: A Vietnamese-compliant Point-of-Sale and Electronic Invoice platform for retail stores. Every sale automatically produces a legally valid hóa đơn điện tử (Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC). All data is store-scoped, role-protected, and accessible via a real-time dashboard.
content.north_star_metric: Time from product scan to issued tax invoice < 10 seconds per transaction.

target_users.pain_point: Manual invoice creation is slow and error-prone
Tax reconciliation is done by hand from printed receipts
No real-time visibility of daily revenue or stock
No central system to manage multiple store locations

epics.title: Foundation — Auth & Multi-tenancy
epics.goal: Every user can log in with the correct role. All data is scoped to a store. Nothing leaks across store boundaries.
epics.completion_criteria: All staff can log in. Admin can manage users and stores. JWT + RBAC enforced on every endpoint.

epics.title: Product Catalog
epics.goal: Every store has a live, accurate product catalog with VNĐ pricing and VAT rates. Cashiers can look up products by SKU or name.
epics.completion_criteria: Admin/manager can create and manage products. Cashiers can search products. priceVnd stored as integer. VAT rate per product.

epics.title: Core POS Flow — Order + Invoice
epics.goal: A cashier can process a sale end-to-end: scan products → confirm payment → system auto-issues a compliant hóa đơn điện tử within 10 seconds.
epics.completion_criteria: Order lifecycle (pending → processing → completed) works. Invoice is auto-issued on order completion. Invoice number is immutable. Tax subtotals calculated correctly in VNĐ.

epics.title: Reporting & Tax Reconciliation
epics.goal: Accountants can export daily/monthly revenue and VAT summaries. Managers can view live dashboard stats.
epics.completion_criteria: GET /reports/daily returns revenue + VAT totals. CSV export of invoices for tax authority submission.

epics.title: Production Hardening
epics.goal: System is ready for real store deployment: E2E tests pass, Docker Compose verified, onboarding guide tested end-to-end.
epics.completion_criteria: Full Playwright E2E suite green. docker compose up produces working system. Onboarding guide verified by a new team member.

sprint_schedule.title: Foundation
sprint_schedule.milestone: Staff can log in. Store multi-tenancy enforced.

sprint_schedule.title: Product Catalog
sprint_schedule.milestone: Store has a live product catalog. Cashier can search products.

sprint_schedule.title: Core POS Flow
sprint_schedule.milestone: MVP: Full sale flow from cart to issued tax invoice.
sprint_schedule.note: MVP candidate. First sprint where the product delivers real business value.

sprint_schedule.title: Reporting & Tax
sprint_schedule.milestone: Accountants can close the month with a CSV export for the tax authority.

sprint_schedule.title: Production Hardening
sprint_schedule.milestone: System deployed to production. Onboarding guide verified.

dependency_chain: auth → store → product → order → invoice → reporting
content.frontend_note: Frontend (React 18 + Vite 5) is deliberately deferred until Sprint 2. Sprint 1 is backend-only to establish the API foundation. Frontend picks up in Sprint 2 with the product catalog UI, and is in full swing from Sprint 3 onward for the POS screen.

deferred_features.reason: Out of MVP scope — product has price/tax but no inventory tracking
Integration with Vietnamese tax authority portal — legal/operational dependency

audit.author: vibe-product-owner
audit.note: Full 5-sprint roadmap created. MVP at Sprint 3. Dependency chain established.
